definitions.gloss: lake surface; surface of a lake
definitions.explanation: The surface of a lake. Often used in descriptive or literary contexts when discussing the appearance, conditions, or reflections on a lake.

examples.japanese: {湖面|こめん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧だ。
{湖面|こめん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{映|うつ}っている→映る：12964_utsuru⟧。
examples.english: The mountains are reflected on the lake surface.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝日|あさひ}→朝日：23495_asahi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{照|て}らされた→照らす：04669_terasu⟧{湖面|こめん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{金色|きんいろ}→金色：05067_kiniro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{輝|かがや}いていた→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧。
examples.english: The lake surface, lit by the morning sun, was shining golden.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{湖|みずうみ}→湖：00867_mizuumi⟧ (lake) and ⟦{面|めん}→面：09933_men⟧ (surface). Follows the same pattern as other surface-related compounds: ⟦{海面|かいめん}→海面：15838_kaimen⟧ (sea surface), ⟦{水面|すいめん}→水面：04307_suimen⟧ (water surface), ⟦{路面|ろめん}→路面：16490_romen⟧ (road surface).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {湖面|こめん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{映|うつ}る→映る：12964_utsuru⟧ — to be reflected on the lake surface
- {湖面|こめん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{凍|こお}る→凍る：02100_kooru⟧ — the lake surface freezes
- {湖面|こめん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{波立|なみだ}つ→波立つ：28434_namidatsu⟧ — the lake surface ripples
- {湖面|こめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{渡|わた}る→渡る：02441_wataru⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧ — wind crossing the lake surface
